assumptions: Unconfirmed appearance and delivery details require art, wardrobe, and camera review.
storyboard_intent: Make the scene's information flow and action continuity drawable shot by shot.

panels.moment: The character notices the first concrete sign of change.
panels.framing: Medium single inherited from the shot list.
panels.foreground: A frame edge that establishes the threshold.
panels.midground: The character and the object receiving their attention.
panels.background: Only the confirmed geography visible from this position.
panels.subject_placement: Character on frame left with attention directed into negative space.
panels.action_direction: The character turns from frame left toward frame right.
panels.movement_state: Character turn beginning; camera remains in the approved shot state.
panels.lighting_note: Preserve the approved motivated source and reveal timing.
panels.audio_cue: The relevant dialogue or environmental cue begins here.
panels.continuity_note: Match eye line, hand state, screen direction, and action phase into the next panel.
panels.dramatic_purpose: Direct attention to the story fact the character can now perceive.
